evidence.source_sentence: The measurements of the intrinsic viscosities were made in a thermostat bath regulated to 25 ± 0.02 °C.

Thermogravimetric analysis (TGA) was performed using a TA Instruments of Hi-res TGA 2950 Thermogravimetric Analyzer. A sample of about 20 mg was put into a clean platinum pan and run under both nitrogen and air atmosphere from room temperature to 800 °C at a heating rate of 10°C/min.
Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) analysis was carried out employing a Perkin–Elmer DSC-7. All DA-polyesters were analyzed from 40 to 250°C under nitrogen purge at the heating rate of 10°C/min.
annealing temperature (80 °C)
Isothermal DSC analysis was also carried out by first heating the sample to the annealing temperature (80 °C) at a rate of 30 °C/min.
frequency of 1 Hz

Dynamic mechanical analysis (DMA) data were collected through a TA Instruments Dynamic Mechanical Analyzer 2980. The measurement was performed at a heating rate of 3°C/min and a frequency of 1 Hz in air.
